name: baseline-flaky-scale
description: Persistent 40% packet loss on 3 of the 4 mid-tier services (svc-a, svc-b, svc-c) via tc netem throughout the experiment. Variant of 'baseline-flaky' for the scale-N topologies (gateway -> svc-a..d -> leaves svc-1..); the ring profile targets svc-01.. which scale-N does not have.
